Overview

Campo Grande is a city in MS with a population of 916,001. Mato Grosso do Sul’s capital, a modern city with wide boulevards, strong gaúcho traditions, and access to the Pantanal and Bonito. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
